name: zvideo_blur_region_vertical
description: zVideo::buff_BlurRegionVertical applies the 16bpp vertical weighted blur over the clamped FX surface region.
known_limits: Tier S remains blocked in the zVideo FX blur cluster. VC5SP3 11.00.7022 /O2 /Ob0 /Zp4 COFF byte compare for 0x48e670 currently fails with 337 unmasked mismatches after masking 60 relocation bytes and trimming 13 VC NOP bytes; BN body is 498 bytes and the VC object body is 512 bytes.

A same-session direct 1-2-1 tap-expression source-shape probe kept behavior passing and improved the prior 371-mismatch baseline. Current worktree source improves the raw mismatch count from 350 to 337 but overshoots body size; byte equivalence remains blocked by stack/local ordering, retail 0x34 frame shape, and vertical pointer-loop codegen drift.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x48e670 validates null/full-surface bounds, rect clipping to top >= 1, inclusive x range, and the 1:2:1 vertical RGB565-safe weighted average into scratch before copying back.
Native smoke zvideo_blur_region_vertical_smoke verifies the clamped vertical blur writes y in [top,bottom) and preserves untouched pixels.
